candidate_components.label: SHRA multifamily-zoned lot area: less than 5 acres
candidate_components.pinpoint: Memo Part I (property criteria), page 2 (lot-size paragraph)

excerpts.text: To qualify, multifamily-zoned lots must be less than 5 acres, and single-family zoned lots must be under 1.5 acres and "vacant." (See FAQ Section, Q.1.)

new_facts_needed: A multifamily-zone classification from an official source.
candidate_components.controlled_value_encoding: lot-area in sq ft of the lot to be subdivided, from a reviewed record. 5 acres = 217,800 sq ft (43,560 sq ft per acre; the conversion is not stated in the memo).
candidate_components.proposed_rule_if_reviewer_agrees: shra-zone-category single_family_listed_zone -> consistent_with_source (this limit does not apply). zone_not_on_single_family_list and lot-area < 217,800 sq ft -> consistent_with_source (below the limit whatever the path). zone_not_on_single_family_list and lot-area >= 217,800 sq ft -> requires_judgment (blocks only if the lot is multifamily-zoned, which no captured source can show).
judgment_or_ambiguity: 'Less than 5 acres' is read as strictly less than; confirm against GCS 66499.41.
The memo does not say whether a designated remainder parcel (AB 130, FAQ Q.23) counts toward the lot area.
Until an official source classifies multifamily zones, this limit can never block.
candidate_components.reviewer_question: Do you agree the 5-acre limit is a strict less-than on the pre-subdivision lot area, and that it must stay non-blocking until an official source defines which zones are multifamily-zoned?

excerpts.text: To qualify, multifamily-zoned lots must be less than 5 acres, and single-family zoned lots must be under 1.5 acres and "vacant." (See FAQ Section, Q.1.)

candidate_components.controlled_value_encoding: lot-area in sq ft of the lot to be subdivided, from a reviewed record. 1.5 acres = 65,340 sq ft.

candidate_components.label: SHRA single-family-zoned lot must also be vacant
candidate_components.pinpoint: Memo Part I, page 2 (lot-size paragraph); FAQ Q.1, page 12 (definition of vacant)

excerpts.text: To qualify, multifamily-zoned lots must be less than 5 acres, and single-family zoned lots must be under 1.5 acres and "vacant." (See FAQ Section, Q.1.)
The SHRA defines “vacant” as a site that has no permanent structure at the time of application, unless the existing structure is abandoned and uninhabitable.

candidate_components.controlled_value_encoding: Reads only shra-zone-category. Vacancy itself stays with la_shra.vacant-site-definition (repo-sourced judgment).
candidate_components.proposed_rule_if_reviewer_agrees: zone_not_on_single_family_list -> consistent_with_source (the memo attaches vacancy to single-family-zoned lots only). single_family_listed_zone -> requires_judgment (vacant is a legal definition). Never disqualifying_per_source, and never decided from a structure count.
judgment_or_ambiguity: FAQ Q.1: a site is vacant if it has no permanent structure at application, unless the structure is abandoned and uninhabitable; documentation lists are non-exhaustive.
Overlaps la_shra.vacant-site-definition, which is repo-sourced and applies to every parcel; decide whether that criterion should be scoped to the single-family path.
